symptom: `create or modify persistent entity M.E (Due: DateTime)` and `alter entity M.E modify attribute Due: DateTime` left a stored `not localized` DateTime not localized with no output saying so; the reporter's script meant Studio Pro's default (localized) and a client compared a UTC wall clock to local now
cause: deliberate carry (#743, #1373): an unstated `localized` keeps the stored LocalizeDate (carryStoredAttributeState / carryStoredLocalizeDate, and the MODIFY ATTRIBUTE site), but nothing reported that the carry had decided the value
file: mdl/executor/cmd_entities.go (carryStoredLocalizeDate now returns whether it kept false; keptNotLocalized, noteKeptNotLocalized; called after the create-or-modify write and after MODIFY ATTRIBUTE)
insight: A preservation rule the statement cannot show needs a line of output when it overrides what the statement appears to say. Kept the rule (maintainer decision) and noted only the surprising direction: unstated + stored false. For create or modify the note is derived from the written result (an unstated DateTime written false can only be the carry, since a new one defaults to true), so it cannot drift from the carry logic. The OData external-entity rewrite shares carryStoredAttributeState but was left without the note
